verdict.rationale: Gumloop provides a Code Sandbox that lets agents execute Python code and shell commands in an isolated cloud environment, which supports dropping into real code within a workflow, but evidence only mentions Python/shell, not JavaScript, and doesn't clearly frame it as a first-class 'code step' node within a broader workflow builder the way dedicated automation tools do. missing for 10: explicit JavaScript code-step support, workflow-builder UI evidence showing a code node inline with other steps, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this capability.
